plainLanguage: Section 114A — Preventing or obstructing service or execution of process. Ufafanuzi huu unafuata statutory text ya R.E. 2022.
meaning: Section 114A must be applied from its exact conduct, custody, authority, knowledge, intent, exception and penalty requirements where applicable.
keyPoints: Use the official statutory wording element by element.
Preserve any express exception, knowledge/intent requirement and stated penalty.
Do not infer liability from the section title alone.

history.summary: Section 114A is recorded in The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Verified against the government-hosted R.E. 2022 PDF.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Every express statutory element should be established from evidence.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Exceptions, lawful authority, custody status and mental elements should not be presumed.

debateQuestion: Je, facts zinatimiza requirements zote za section 114A?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
